headline: Breaking / Guai Guai Company Responds: Labor-Management Consultation on Strike Officially Concludes | ETtoday Finance Cloud | ETtoday News Cloud
summary: The labor dispute tied to the transformation of the Zhongli plant of snack brand Guai Guai has ended. Labor and management signed a mediation record and a joint statement under the Taoyuan City Labor Bureau.
why: Guai Guai is a Taiwanese snack brand, and labor disputes over plant restructuring can affect production continuity and operating costs.
